With an experienced lawn, tree & shrub, and outdoor service professional, you can expect expert advice and service that goes beyond just healthy grass.  At TruGreen, we’ll help you attain the lawn you’ve always dreamed of with specialized lawn care services, plus the added benefit of tree and shrub care and nuisance insect control. With our expert advice and professional services, we’re proud to be able to offer a comprehensive and customized treatment plan from an array of treatments and services from aeration, to weed control, fertilization, mosquito, tree and shrub care, and more. 

With our professional lawn care services, we’ll help you establish and maintain a lawn that you can be proud of all year round. We tailor our solutions to meet the needs of your lawn plus trees and shrubs, during prime growth and maintenance seasons, ensuring healthy plant growth and proper insect and disease control.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src=”https://trugreenupnorth.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/200923_Robert_Holland_Trugreen_12545-Edit-Edit_web-scaled.jpg” title_text=”200923_Robert_Holland_Trugreen_12545-Edit-Edit_web” _builder_version=”4.20.0″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.19.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.8em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

When it comes to lawn care and outdoor maintenance needs, it can be overwhelming knowing where to start, the best methods and products to use for your unique situation, and knowing when to seek professional help. With TruGreen services, our friendly team of experts will guide you every step of the way in achieving a lawn and outdoor space you can enjoy and can be proud of. The TruGreen Guarantee assures we will gladly visit your property as needed between scheduled visits to ensure your satisfaction. We use high quality,professional-grade products, which are not available to the general public, making our quality of service surprisingly more cost-effective than most DIY methods. We also use science-driven expertise to ensure healthy plant growth and protection for your lawn care and outdoor needs, as well as scientifically designed treatment programs to maximize effectiveness. Each TruGreen specialist undergoes comprehensive, best-in-class, science-based training to ensure every service is performed the right way, with the right product and equipment, at the right time. They will help set expectations, educate, and consult with you on how to achieve your desired results, leaving you to sit back and relax, knowing that the hard work is taken care of.
